references.text: The Lord will create strife between nations, which reflects the conflicts mentioned in Matthew 24:7.
Micah prophesies about nations rising up against each other, parallel to Jesus' words about nation against nation.
Zechariah speaks of a great conflict between kingdoms, similar to what is described in Matthew 24:7.
This verse in Matthew itself serves as an explanation and elaboration of the events mentioned in verse 7.
Luke gives a parallel description of end-time signs, including nations in conflict and natural disasters.
John's Revelation contains symbolism about war and conflict, which can be seen as related to Matthew 24:7.
